answer: The fee is charged through a nectar debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the crystal totals, and the karst anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 45 units per epoch, sustaining 114 aliases for 40 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. That is 28 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
